source_class: remake-original dialogue, not extracted original game text
policy: New voices must be performed and lawfully recorded/commissioned; do not voice-clone or impersonate prior performers. No copyrighted franchise recordings.
audio_master: 48 kHz or 96 kHz / 24-bit or 32-bit float WAV recorded dry, no clipping; source files are not committed unless cleared.
delivery: 48 kHz mono PCM 24-bit processed WAV, -18 LUFS radio/-19 LUFS world, -1.5 dBTP upper bound, conservative dynamics and readable subtitles.
processing: Light high-pass, restrained high-end rolloff, gentle compression, 2-pass loudness matching. Do not bake music, heavy static, spatial reverb or severe phone-band distortion into masters.

snake.name: Solid Snake
snake.performance: Measured, precise, alert, curious. Concrete question inflections, often echoing a key term; younger and less battle-worn than later portrayals.
snake.avoid: No heroic shouting as a default, no celebrity or prior-actor voice cloning, no artificially aged rasp.

big_boss.name: Real Big Boss (radio)
big_boss.performance: Grounded, confident low-mid presence, moderate tempo, protective command clarity. A subtle thought-beat before sensitive orders, not obvious villainy.
big_boss.avoid: No theatrical evil voice and no imitation of any named actor.

schneider.name: Kyle Schneider
schneider.performance: Slightly hurried but intelligible. Practical, vulnerable, frustrated by gaps in his knowledge; controlled breath.
schneider.avoid: No false omniscience, excessive radio static or generic nasal robot voice.

gray_fox.name: Human Gray Fox
gray_fox.performance: Dry, contained, fatigued breathing with intact elite-soldier precision. Strength rises briefly to communicate Metal Gear intelligence.
gray_fox.avoid: No cyborg filters, ninja voice effects or exaggerated pain.

shotmaker.name: Shoot Gunner / Shotmaker
shotmaker.performance: Confident and territorial, clipped and chest-resonant; pride slips as repeated attacks fail. Keep words readable across gunfire.
shotmaker.avoid: No cartoon roar, no unverified accent imitation, no endlessly repeated taunts.

guard.name: Outer Heaven guard
guard.performance: Procedural, short calls; escalate intensity according to firsthand evidence. Real breaths before contact reports and challenge.
guard.avoid: No psychic callouts, constant barking or voice that remains stable when interrupted.
